evidence.description: Datasheet documents the author-prepared Virginia county reconciliation as the sole manual data-cleaning exception.
evidence.quote:
When merging county population data from the BEA with county employment data from the BLS,
I noticed a few discrepancies in how county data in Virginia is reported. For example, in the BEA’s
population data, “Albemarle, VA” and “Charlottesville, VA” are combined as “Albemarle +
Charlottesville, VA.” Similarly, “Dinwiddie, VA,” “Colonial Heights, VA,” and “Petersburg, VA”
are combined as “Dinwiddie, Colonial Heights + Petersburg, VA.” These discrepancies led to
mismatches, so I manually cleaned up the counties reported as combined values in the BEA data.
